# apple_submit_retention_message_version (Action)

Submits a retention message version to App Review, by adding it to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one. The version needs a localization. People see a retention message only after App Review approves a version of it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_retention_message_version" "first" {
  config {
    app_id                       = data.apple_app.example.id
    retention_message_version_id = apple_retention_message_version.first.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `retention_message_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version, e.g. `apple_retention_message_version.example.id`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of the review submission: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`. Defaults to `IOS`.
- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add other items to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
